briefdescription.para: Public API for NDXL vertex creation, state and parameter management, and nearest neighbour traversal.

detaileddescription.para: Declares the NDXLVertex object, representing a node in a network. Provides functions for vertex construction, destruction, nearest neighbour traversal, and state and parameter querying.
